title: Re-point approvals.record-page-decisions acceptance[4]: a forged decision by a caller who cannot read the request answers 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND, not 403 FORBIDDEN
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33058 · approvals.record-page-decisions · acceptance[4]

Kind: checklist re-point (stale spec), no product change.

## Observed at ee9ad834 (reproduced on the approvals route, /reject and the action door)
As a contributor-bound member who can read showcase_project `p28JyMGucv-7Y-Yy` but is not a participant of its pending exec_review request: `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/<request id>/approve {}` → 404 `{"code":"REQUEST_NOT_FOUND"}`; the request stays pending. The clause expects 403 FORBIDDEN "is not a pending approver".

## Why the product is right
`ApprovalService.refuseUnreadableRequest` (packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts) answers a caller who may not READ the request exactly as a missing id, so the request's existence never leaks; FORBIDDEN is reserved for a caller who can read the request but holds no slot. The rest of acceptance[4] held: the member's approvals read is `[]`, the record page shows no decision buttons, and the admin's override folding is correct.

## Proposed clause
"…a forged decision by a non-participant who cannot read the request answers 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND and the request stays pending; one by a reader who holds no slot answers 403 FORBIDDEN." Same 404 reading applies to request-page-reply A1, quorum-m-of-n S4 and decision-action-matrix A6/N2 (noted in the browser record). Bump the revision and add a history row.
